item.ancient_extensions.pokeball_pouch.d: Stores Poké Balls only. Right-click to open.
item.ancient_extensions.pokeball_pouch.p: Place on the ground to set down, or use in hand to open.
item.ancient_extensions.regional_passpor: Your stamped survey origin—choose once, then carry it on every route.
item.ancient_extensions.regional_survey_: Your live field log—goals, catches, and migration progress.
item.ancient_extensions.ancient_professo: Right-click to pitch a survey camp ahead of you. Granted once when you join this world. Not craftable.
ancient_extensions.kit.welcome: The Ancient Professor left you a Field Kit. Open your inventory and right-click it on open ground.
ancient_extensions.kit.welcome_hint: Pitch your camp to begin the Regional Survey.
ancient_extensions.kit.tooltip_use: Faces open ground in front of you when used.
ancient_extensions.kit.lectern_hint: The Regional Survey Briefing is on the camp lectern—take a copy from your pack too.
ancient_extensions.kit.given: Ancient Professor's Field Kit added to your inventory.
ancient_extensions.kit.deployed: You pitched the survey camp. Supplies are in your pack—the chest holds backup gear.
ancient_extensions.kit.survey_hint: Only catches count toward the Regional Survey (PC storage does not). Use /ancientextensions survey
ancient_extensions.kit.chest_hint: Extra supplies were stored in the camp chest.
ancient_extensions.kit.already_used: This kit has already been opened on your journey.
ancient_extensions.kit.no_space: There is not enough open ground nearby to pitch the camp. Try a clearer area.
ancient_extensions.advancement.pitch_fie: Pitch the Ancient Professor's field camp to begin the Regional Survey.
ancient_extensions.command.survey: Regional Survey — Caught: %s | RP: %s | Tier: %s | Kit used: %s
ancient_extensions.command.migration: Migration (%s) — Leg %s/%s | This leg: %s catches | Season completions: %s | Next route RP: %s
ancient_extensions.migration.leg_complet: Migration leg complete (%s/%s). Move to the next biome on the route.
ancient_extensions.migration.diminished_: Repeat route reward is reduced for this season (completion #%s).
ancient_extensions.journal.welcome: You also received a Regional Survey Journal—right-click it anytime to review your goals.
ancient_extensions.journal.hint: Open your Regional Survey Journal to see which goals are done and what is next.
ancient_extensions.journal.given: Regional Survey Journal added to your inventory.
ancient_extensions.journal.tooltip_use: Right-click to open your field log.
ancient_extensions.journal.empty: No survey data yet. Pitch your camp and catch Pokémon in the wild.
ancient_extensions.journal.goal.pitch_ca: Pitch the Ancient Professor's survey camp
ancient_extensions.journal.progress.migr: Route ready—find migratory species in the biomes below
ancient_extensions.journal.goal.register: Register your survey origin on the passport
ancient_extensions.journal.origin_pendin: Survey origin: not registered (use your passport)
ancient_extensions.passport.welcome: You received a Regional Survey Passport—right-click it to choose your origin region (Kanto, Johto, and others). This choice is permanent.
ancient_extensions.passport.given: Regional Survey Passport added to your inventory.
ancient_extensions.passport.choose_promp: Open the region list and stamp your passport with your home region.
ancient_extensions.passport.not_register: Your passport is not stamped yet. Right-click it to choose your origin.
ancient_extensions.passport.footer: Valid for all seasonal migration routes on this world.
ancient_extensions.origin.chosen_hint: Your journal and migration bonuses now reference this region. Other players will see your colored region tag in chat and above your head.
ancient_extensions.origin.already_chosen: Your origin is already stamped on the passport and cannot be changed.
ancient_extensions.origin.invalid: That is not a valid survey region.
ancient_extensions.passport.gui.official: Document No. RSA-001 · Not valid without wax seal
ancient_extensions.passport.gui.unstampe: Select your survey origin, then receive your wax seal.
ancient_extensions.passport.gui.footer: Valid on all seasonal migration routes.
ancient_extensions.region.kanto.blurb: The classic heartland—oak routes, league dreams, and endless tall grass.
ancient_extensions.region.johto.blurb: Legends linger among towers and quiet routes between mountains and sea.
ancient_extensions.region.hoenn.blurb: Land and sea intertwine; volcanic paths and tropical shores shape every survey.
ancient_extensions.region.sinnoh.blurb: Mythic peaks and harsh winters—migratory lines bend around Mount Coronet.
ancient_extensions.region.unova.blurb: Urban skylines and distant frontiers—contrasts that define modern field work.
ancient_extensions.region.kalos.blurb: Elegant valleys and radiant meadows where beauty and battle meet.
ancient_extensions.region.alola.blurb: Island chains and guardian spirits—every leg of migration crosses open ocean.
ancient_extensions.region.galar.blurb: Rolling wild areas and stadium culture—open moors host seasonal wanderers.
ancient_extensions.region.paldea.blurb: A vast open region—treasure hunts and terastal light guide surveyors inland.
